boundary: Descriptive action counts across repeated checkpoint deployments are not independent-world efficacy estimates.

Performance means were independently recalculated from all 24 Q checkpoint/question ledgers; bootstrap intervals and promotion booleans are attributed to the existing selection analysis, not recomputed.
The same 5376 archives were read twice for independent semantic cross-tabs; these are not additional environment executions.
An exploration flag on a logged fallback action identifies the immediate recorded trigger, not the counterfactual effect of removing exploration from learning.
No same-state BC forward pass, retraining, intervention ablation, new holdout or official evaluation was performed.
